headlines.title: Armed bystander distracted gunman in fatal In-N-Out shooting
headlines.description: The shooter was identified as Chad Williams, 24. He fatally shot himself, authorities said at a news conference.

headlines.title: Sen. Bernie Moreno says former son-in-law Max Miller shouldn’t serve in Congress following abuse allegations
headlines.description: Rep. Max Miller, R-Ohio, denied allegations that he abused the senator’s daughter and chastised him for speaking out.

headlines.title: More than 600 structures damaged in Washington state wildfires
headlines.description: A wildfire burning northwest of downtown Spokane, Washington, has damaged more than 600 structures as officials continue to assess the destruction.

headlines.title: Video captures midair collision of Greek firefighting helicopters
headlines.description: Video captured a deadly midair collision of Greek firefighting helicopters west of Athens. Greek fire officials said two crew members from one of the helicopters were killed in the incident.

headlines.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend
headlines.description: President Donald Trump agreed to pause attacks on Iran on Saturday, citing “perimeters of a deal” that would end Tehran’s “nuclear threat” and reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

headlines.title: U.S. agrees to pause attacks on Iran subject to ‘rapidly’ making deal, Trump says
headlines.description: The deal would include reopening the Strait of Hormuz and ending Tehran’s “nuclear threat,” the president said.

headlines.title: GOP Sen. John Kennedy: ‘I wouldn’t bet my house on’ Blanche’s confirmation as attorney general
headlines.description: In an exclusive interview with Meet the Press, Sen. John Kennedy (R-La.) discusses concerns over the Trump administration’s so-called “anti-weaponization” fund, the subject of the Senate holdup over Todd Blanche’s confirmation as attorney general.

headlines.title: Trump rebukes Jeanine Pirro over decision to drop Reflecting Pool vandalism case
headlines.description: President Donald Trump criticized longtime ally Jeanine Pirro Saturday after she agreed to drop a case against a former Olympic canoeist who was accused of vandalizing the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool.

headlines.title: Spain ramps up security amid migrant crisis
headlines.description: Officials in Spain were ramping up security on Saturday after tens of thousands of migrants crossed into an enclave on the border with Morocco. NBC News’ Matt Bradley reports.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Govs. Kevin Stitt and Wes Moore say civility can win general elections but primaries promote partisanship
headlines.description: Stitt and Moore said social media contributes to negativity and polarization in politics and urged more in-person connections.
